note: v2810: REG-750 - v2809 moved status_payload behind a timing shell and five gates went red. Three of them read _app_ver, which recovers the RUNNING version from status_payload.__code__.co_consts on purpose so a live process cannot report the disk version - a shell has no such literal, so the stamp became v? and the refactor re-created the exact v2155 defect without touching its subject. The timing is now inlined and the name preserved, plus a law asserting the function still carries a vNNNN literal.
